title: Two more hostile mobs
body:
You may be wondering: how many hostile mobs are there in Disorder of the Stone? Minecraft Alpha had 5 in total. Disorder of the Stone has bumped that up to 14.

It looked so sad, and it really, really wanted to be in the mod. When asked whether it would be fine with being like modern Minecraft's Illusioner, which doesn't spawn naturally but can still be obtained with commands, it started crying, and the only way to get it to stop was to make it part of the mod.

![image: Two more hostile mobs](media/1464790552930287830.png)

It even did a little dance to impress, and said it had spent months practising balancing on top of a ball just so it could attack you with it. There was no way to say no.

So now there will be 16 naturally spawning hostile mobs, not counting the minibosses.
